goal: Prevent reuse of normalized production PO numbers for new production orders while preserving existing historical duplicates and permitting only the exact reviewed historical admissions.
prohibited_actions: Do not mutate shared preview or production outside the governed reviewed workflow; read-only target proof and acceptance checks are permitted.
Do not rewrite historical production orders or remove historical duplicates.
Do not create broad source, service-role, or import bypasses around PO reservation.
Do not claim tests, independent reviews, CI, merge, or live proof passed without direct evidence.
required_checks: docker exec -i codex-po-no-reuse-01a12aec psql -U postgres -d normalized_test -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 < supabase/tests/production_po_no_reuse.sql
assumptions: The migration and business-rule draft were authored before this contract was prepared; the contract is prospective and does not backdate or authorize that earlier work retroactively.
Historical duplicates remain unchanged; any legacy admission is limited to the exact frozen UUID manifest and does not create a date-wide or source-key bypass.
No current source-key upsert compatibility claim is made without separate evidence.
The isolated PostgreSQL regression, independent approvals, CI, and live proof remain unverified and must be completed by the coordinator or assigned reviewers.
Generation 2 explicitly declares the production_order trigger discovered by the static claim lexer; generation 1 remains preserved in its published immutable ref and Git history.

Generation 3 follows the supported refresh helper; that helper committed the current-main implementation and stopped because it cannot rerun SQL checks. Coordinator reruns the exact isolated SQL checks and uses a catalog-only probe qualified under the read-only execution role. No production permissions were broadened.

Generation 4 follows native active-claim version supersession after main advanced; SQL bytes are unchanged, and the catalog probe ledger key follows reserved version 20261013201822. Older approvals do not authorize this changed head.
stop_conditions: Stop if any writer can bypass the reservation guard or if normalization does not match the reviewed PO identity rule.
Stop if historical duplicate rows are rewritten or admitted beyond the exact frozen UUID manifest.
Stop if static SQL or isolated PostgreSQL tests fail.
Stop before merge without two independent exact-head approvals and required CI checks.
Stop before production acceptance without the exact bounded live proof and a verified production target.
